paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
coupling_convention: d_n in e*cm (amplitude of oscillating neutron EDM)
notes: CASPEr-electric solid-state NMR search (207Pb in PMN-PT) for axion-like dark matter in the 162-166 neV mass range (39.1-40.2 MHz Compton frequency, 1 MHz band around 39.65 MHz). The paper reports flat 95% CL upper bounds over this range: |g_d| < 9.5e-4 GeV^-2, equivalent to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude d_n < 1.0e-21 e*cm (emitted here as a two-point flat bound), oscillating theta_QCD amplitude < 4.3e-6, and gradient coupling |g_aNN| < 2.8e-1 GeV^-1 (AxionNeutron-type, not emitted). DM density assumption: rho_DM = 3.6e-42 GeV^4 ≈ 0.47 GeV/cm^3. The paper also contains a secondary gradient-coupling limit and future sensitivity projections (Fig. S9), but the primary extracted result is the measured EDM-coupling bound. Detailed per-frequency limit curve (Fig. 3a) not available numerically; the quoted range-wide bound is used.
